apartments.name: Sebastiana (75 m²)
apartments.description: Traced 1:1 from the SVG floor plan: closed 7-vertex perimeter + 7 interior wall segments, extruded to 2.5 m height. Single uniform scale anchored at drawing depth 544 px = 13.0 m (~2.39 cm/px), origin at outline top-left; width works out to 7.15 m. Room names taken from the source labels (areas excluded as unreliable). One opening: stone-framed entrance (no door) between kitchen and living room, centered on the shared wall segment.
